components.name: Primary Queue Button
components.description: The dock-anchored action that submits the bounded run request.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A subordinate text action for Close, History, disclosure, or copy controls.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet{display:inline-flex;min-height:38px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted,#5e6675);font:600 14px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),color 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-button-quiet:hover{border-color:var(--border,#e1e4e9);background:#f5f6f9;color:var(--text,#111827)}.ds-button-quiet:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-button-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1e55e6);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Connection Context Chip
components.description: A compact dot-plus-label readout for authenticated connection and runtime context.

components.name: Composer Field
components.description: The compact labeled control used for language, isolation, limits, and standard input.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:5px;color:#505969;font:650 11px/1.45 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field select{width:100%;min-height:40px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #cfd4dc;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--text,#111827);font:400 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field select:hover{border-color:#919aaa}.ds-field select:focus-visible{border-color:var(--kernel,#1e55e6);outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1e55e6);outline-offset:2px}.ds-field small{color:#727b89;font:400 10px/1.4 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}

components.name: Compose History Tabs
components.description: Equal dock tabs that keep run composition and ledger history one action apart.

components.name: Numbered Code Editor
components.description: The white source editor with a narrow numbered gutter and whole-shell focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-code-editor{display:grid;min-height:168px;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d4d8df;border-radius:4px;background:#fff}.ds-code-editor:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1e55e6);outline-offset:2px}.ds-code-editor ol{margin:0;padding:9px 5px 9px 0;border-right:1px solid #e5e8ed;background:#f7f8fa;color:#8a93a1;font:400 11px/21px "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;list-style:none;text-align:right}.ds-code-editor label{display:block}.ds-code-editor textarea{width:100%;min-height:168px;padding:9px 10px;resize:vertical;border:0;background:#fff;color:var(--code-ink,#1e3a8a);font:400 12px/21px "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",Menlo,monospace;outline:0}.ds-visually-hidden{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Selected History Row
components.description: The current run in History, finalized with a pale wash and one-pixel cobalt leading seam.
components.css: .ds-history-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:78px minmax(0,1fr) 48px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:62px;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9);border-radius:0;background:#fff;box-shadow:none;color:var(--text,#111827);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-history-row:hover{background:#f3f6fd}.ds-history-row[aria-current="true"]{background:var(--selection,#edf2ff);box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 var(--kernel,#1e55e6)}.ds-history-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1e55e6);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-history-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:var(--healthy,#198754);font:700 9.5px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-history-status i{width:9px;height:9px;border:2px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}.ds-history-id{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}.ds-history-id strong{overflow:hidden;font:650 11.5px/1.3 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-history-id small,.ds-history-duration{color:var(--text-muted,#5e6675);font:400 10.5px/1.2 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-history-duration{justify-self:end;white-space:nowrap}

minimum isolation: none

components.css: .ds-transcript-stage{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 28px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:78px;padding:14px 18px 14px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--carbon-border,#29323e);background:var(--carbon,#12171e);color:var(--carbon-text,#e7ebf1)}.ds-transcript-stage::after{position:absolute;top:36px;bottom:-37px;left:132px;width:1px;background:#344050;content:""}.ds-transcript-stage>time{padding:2px 10px 0 0;color:#8e99a8;font:400 10.5px/1.35 "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-transcript-marker{position:relative;z-index:1;width:16px;height:16px;margin:2px auto 0;border:2px solid #6f91e8;border-radius:50%;background:var(--carbon,#12171e)}.ds-transcript-stage>div{min-width:0;padding-left:14px}.ds-transcript-stage h3{margin:0 0 7px;color:var(--carbon-accent,#79a0ff);font:700 11px/1.45 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.015em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-transcript-stage pre{margin:0;color:#d4dae3;font:400 11.5px/1.55 "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap}.ds-transcript-stage:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1e55e6);outline-offset:-3px}

components.name: Result and Record Section
components.description: A flat light-sheet section for server-reported outcome and portable proof.
components.css: .ds-result-section{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9);background:var(--surface-raised,#f5f6f9);color:var(--text,#111827);font:400 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-result-section header{display:flex;min-height:76px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:15px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9);background:rgba(253,254,255,.98)}.ds-result-section h3{margin:0;font-size:15px}.ds-result-section p{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--text-muted,#5e6675);font-size:10px}.ds-result-section button{min-height:36px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted,#5e6675);font:600 12px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-result-section button:hover{border-color:var(--border,#e1e4e9);background:#fff;color:var(--text,#111827)}.ds-result-section button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1e55e6);outline-offset:2px}.ds-result-section dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));margin:0;background:#fff}.ds-result-section dl>div{min-height:62px;padding:10px;border-right:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#e1e4e9)}.ds-result-section dt{color:var(--text-muted,#5e6675);font-size:11px}.ds-result-section dd{margin:8px 0 0;font:700 14px/1.2 "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace}.ds-result-success{color:var(--healthy,#198754)}

narrative.overview:
Coop is an exacting operations surface built from two materials with different responsibilities. Chalk-white command planes hold intent, configuration, history, and proof; a deep carbon well holds the truthful chronological run transcript. The contrast makes execution the focal object without dressing the product as a novelty terminal.

Cobalt marks deliberate operator intent: queueing, selection, focus, active navigation, and transcript structure. Green, amber, red, and slate report real execution state. One-pixel seams, compact square controls, restrained type, and server-qualified language keep the system direct and credible.

The dashboard expresses the world as a Compose/History dock, dominant transcript, and contextual Result & record sheet. That composition belongs to the run workflow rather than every future Coop surface. The durable system is the material hierarchy—chalk around carbon—plus the ordered move from requested intent to accepted policy, execution, result, and portable proof.
keyCharacteristics: Chalk command and proof planes surrounding one dominant carbon execution well.
Intent Cobalt reserved for operator action, focus, selection, and chronological structure.
Semantic colors paired with explicit labels, markers, and server-reported facts.
Compact square controls and one-pixel seams instead of decorative card chrome.
Humanist system sans for operation; monospace for source, identifiers, time, and evidence.
Responsive movement from simultaneous context to one focused Compose, History, Run, or Result surface.

rules.name: The Cobalt Means Intent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for deliberate action, focus, current navigation, selection seams, and transcript structure; do not use it as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Semantics Mean State Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red, and slate must correspond to an actual reported state and remain paired with text or marker shape.

rules.name: The Chalk Around Carbon Rule
rules.body: Command, composition, and proof stay on chalk planes; the chronological execution transcript owns the carbon well.

rules.name: The Machine Facts Are Monospace Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for source, IDs, timestamps, limits, hashes, events, output, JSON, and exact values; keep actions and explanations in the system sans.

rules.name: The Density Comes From Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce marketing-scale type. Establish priority through weight, alignment, plane contrast, and four-pixel rhythm.

rules.name: The Composition Stays With the Run Rule
rules.body: Preserve the dock → transcript → result anatomy for this run workflow, but do not force those widths or three regions onto unrelated Coop surfaces.

rules.name: The Sequence Never Reflows Rule
rules.body: Responsive layout may change which plane is visible, never the order from requested intent through accepted policy, execution, outcome, and proof.

rules.name: The Seam Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: If an element does not overlap another plane, separate it with tone, spacing, or a one-pixel border before considering shadow.

rules.name: The Square Desk Rule
rules.body: Composer, History, transcript, policy ribbon, and result sheet meet edge to edge; do not turn them into detached rounded cards.

rules.name: The One-Pixel Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected History row uses Selection Wash plus exactly one cobalt pixel on its leading edge. Do not restore the old heavy rail.

dos: Do make the chronological transcript the dominant visual and interaction surface.
Do keep Compose, History, requested policy, and Result & record on chalk planes around the carbon well.
Do reserve cobalt for intent, current navigation, visible focus, transcript structure, and the one-pixel History seam.
Do pair semantic state color with explicit labels, markers, and server-reported facts.
Do preserve the visual separation between requested intent, accepted policy, observed result, and portable proof.
Do retain visible focus, 44px coarse-pointer targets, reduced motion, forced colors, 320px reflow, and exact-content scrolling.
donts: Don't revive equal-weight dashboard panels, decorative card grids, or the old queue / output / inspector hierarchy.
Don't style the carbon transcript as a fake terminal window with chrome, traffic-light controls, or novelty prompts.
Don't spread dark material across the Compose dock, command bar, or Result & record sheet.
Don't thicken the selected History indicator beyond its final one-pixel cobalt seam.
Don't merge requested policy with observed posture or imply that server-provided proof was independently verified.
Don't add gradients, glass, pill-heavy controls, decorative rasters, or theatrical security styling.
